questions.prompt: Granted that the night was dark, the scouts found the hidden path.
questions.answer: Fuerit nox ātra, explōrātōrēs occultum callem invēnērunt.

questions.prompt: Grant that fortune is fickle; the wise man fears nothing.
questions.answer: Sit fortūna incōnstāns; sapiēns nihil timet.

questions.prompt: Granted that the wounds are grievous, the soldier refuses to yield.
questions.answer: Sint vulnera gravia, mīles cēdere recūsat.

questions.prompt: Grant that they captured the city; they could not hold it long.
questions.answer: Cēperint urbem; eam diū tenēre nōn potuērunt.

questions.prompt: Granted that the winter is harsh, the farmer tends his golden fields.
questions.answer: Sit hiems aspera, agricola aureōs agrōs colit.

questions.prompt: Grant that the orator spoke falsely; the crowd believed him eagerly.
questions.answer: Locūtus sit ōrātor falsō; turba eī cupidē crēdidit.

questions.prompt: Granted that there are no ships in the harbor, the merchants do not despair.
questions.answer: Nē sint nāvēs in portū, mercātōrēs nōn dēspērant.

questions.prompt: Granted that the gods are silent, the priest continues the sacred rites.
questions.answer: Sint diī tacitī, sacerdōs sacra prōsequitur.

questions.prompt: Grant that the mountain is steep; the eager travelers climb it.
questions.answer: Sit mōns arduus; viātōrēs cupidī eum ascendunt.

questions.prompt: Grant that the letters have been lost; the messenger remembers the words.
Granted that the sea rages, the fearless helmsman holds his course.
questions.answer: Saeviat mare, impavidus gubernātor cursum tenet.

questions.prompt: Granted that there is no water in the well, the herds drink from the stream.
questions.answer: Nē sit aqua in puteō, gregēs ē rīvō bibunt.

questions.prompt: Grant that both brothers were guilty; the judge spared them.
questions.answer: Fuerint ambō frātrēs nocentēs; iūdex eīs pepercit.
